Starting at €749 for two hours, this experience includes a licensed skipper, drinks, snacks, and 21% VAT—perfect for influencers, couples, or brand campaigns. Depart from the iconic Puerto Banús and cruise along Marbella’s coastline as the sun dips behind La Concha mountain.

Why Choose a Marbella Photoshoot Yacht Sunset Session?

Marbella’s sunset is legendary, and a private yacht provides an exclusive vantage point. The Marbella photoshoot yacht sunset session 2031 combines luxury, privacy, and the best natural light. Unlike crowded beach shoots, you control the backdrop—whether it’s the sleek lines of Puerto Banús, the rugged cliffs of Cala del Faro, or the open sea. Our fleet includes the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax), both ideal for intimate shoots.

What to Expect During Your Sunset Session

Your 2-hour session begins at Puerto Banús. You’ll cruise along the coast towards Cabopino or Estepona, depending on wind. The skipper will position the yacht for the best angles—whether you want the Marbella skyline or the open sea. Bring your own camera, drone, or hire a photographer; no extra fees apply.

How to Book Your 2031 Sunset Photoshoot

Reserve your Marbella photoshoot yacht sunset session 2031 online or via WhatsApp. For the standard €749 package, select your date and time. For custom requests—like a longer session or a specific yacht—contact us via WhatsApp. We recommend booking at least 2 weeks in advance during peak season (June–September).
